builds.summary: W target-max-HP scaling uses .0002 bonus armor + .0002 bonus MR plus .08. Full All Out charge adds up to 80% of damage as true damage; resist purchases target the pre-conversion coefficient.
builds.goal: W target-max-HP scaling uses .0002 bonus armor + .0002 bonus MR plus .08. Full All Out charge adds up to 80% of damage as true damage; resist purchases target the pre-conversion coefficient.
builds.hypothesis:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for [0.4]-@MaxDuration.1@s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by [25]%. Then, he rams forward, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165] + [0.08 + (0.0002) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.0002) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for [0.5]-[1.75]s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional [10]-[80]% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to [70]% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.
JakSho ramps both bonus resists; Force of Nature ramps MR; Randuin/Thornmail/Unending Despair add armor and Visage adds MR. These feed W resistance scaling. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Jak'Sho, The Protean, Force of Nature, Randuin's Omen, Thornmail, Spirit Visage, Unending Despair. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
